notes: Julia-1 typed decisions (litert-community/Julia-1-LiteRT, Hub revision b92a0d21eb1aedad6afdc815e027a47896d16eb3, published 2026-09-30): SupersonicLabs/Julia-1 (rev a85b1273, Apache-2.0) = mmBERT-small encoder + typed decision head (laya's DecisionModel at half width), one state + typed questions (choice / score / noul) -> one logit per option. Host-lookup form: the host reads the token table (shipped julia1_token_table_fp16.bin, sha256 5c7ad7bd7325d4d230a822d1ecee5e33b6c36376df1c028e8e7ddafb7d43be9c) and feeds embeddings, so the table precision is a host condition, not a graph property. fp16 safety rewrites (LayerNorm 2^-k pre-scale, mask -1e4, q 1/8 pre-scale) are fp32 bit-identical. GpuOptions(precision = FP32) is the validated setting. artifact_sha256 = the Hub LFS sha256 (API siblings.lfs, read 2026-10-09) = sha256 of the lane's export. Reference for parity = the author's implementation on CPU fp32 (fixtures/oracle_typed.json, oracle_parity.json). Lane record: ~/code/standup/handoffs/2026-09-30-julia-1-litert.md; run dir /Users/USER/code/codex-conversions/2026-09-30/julia1-litert; records written 2026-10-09 by scripts/litert_compat_records.py. Window N=512: 706 fixture rows (306 boundary + 400 saturated). The NPU row is the shipped graph on the HTP (JIT): it runs whole and answers wrong (fp16 rounding; Mac emulation: encoder in fp16 max |dprob| 0.087, head in fp16 0.0014). The wfp16 graph and the row-LayerNorm builds were not shipped: no record (#174(3)); the wfp16 graph on the HTP gave 684/706.
